notes.title: Minor Update - 1.02 - More Fuel!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

An update to Burger Butt has been released. The update should be applied automatically when you restart Burger Butt. 

This minor update includes:
[u]MORE FUEL SPAWNS![/u]

If you've been struggling to beat your high scores due to running out of fuel without a fair chance to get more, this is the update for you!

If you have any feedback/bugs to report, please either post it on the Steam Forums or tweet us @TheFloorChicken

Happy Burger Butting!

- FCTony
